hikes.name: Hoh River Trail to Five Mile Island
hikes.blurb: Flat miles through the moss-draped Hoh Rain Forest beside a milky glacial river, elk likely.

hikes.name: Hall of Mosses
hikes.blurb: A short loop under maples hung with curtains of moss, the rain forest at its most magical.

hikes.name: Rialto Beach to Hole-in-the-Wall
hikes.blurb: Along a driftwood beach to a sea arch with tide pools; check the tide before going through.

hikes.name: Third Beach
hikes.blurb: Through forest to a long cove with a waterfall dropping straight onto the sand at the far end.

hikes.name: Ozette Triangle
hikes.blurb: Cedar boardwalks to the coast, three miles of beach past ancient petroglyphs, then back through the forest.

hikes.name: Sol Duc Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy old-growth walk to a falls splitting into several streams into a narrow slot.

hikes.name: Deer Lake
hikes.blurb: Past Sol Duc Falls and up Canyon Creek's cascades to a forest lake, the gateway to the High Divide.

hikes.name: Spruce Railroad Trail and Devil's Punchbowl
hikes.blurb: Along Lake Crescent's old railroad grade to a footbridge over a clear, deep cove.

hikes.name: Pyramid Mountain
hikes.blurb: Climbing from Lake Crescent's north shore to a wartime aircraft-spotting cabin above the lake.

hikes.name: Second Beach
hikes.blurb: A short forest walk to a wide beach with sea stacks lined up offshore, a classic sunset spot.

hikes.name: Shi Shi Beach and Point of the Arches
hikes.blurb: A muddy forest trail, then two miles of wild beach to a row of sea stacks and arches.

hikes.name: Cape Flattery
hikes.blurb: Boardwalk through forest to cliff-edge platforms at the northwest tip of the lower 48.

hikes.name: Mount Storm King
hikes.blurb: Steep switchbacks to a ridge over Lake Crescent's deep blue water (the last bit is roped scrambling).

hikes.name: Marymere Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy walk under big trees to a 90-foot falls in a fern grotto.

hikes.name: Aurora Peak
hikes.blurb: From Aurora Creek Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to the top of Aurora Peak (4,366 ft), with about 4,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bogachiel Peak
hikes.blurb: From Sol Duc Trailhead, a 15.2-mile round trip to the top of Bogachiel Peak (5,452 ft), with about 4,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Kloochman Rock
hikes.blurb: From Queets River Trailhead, a 10.8-mile round trip to the top of Kloochman Rock (3,067 ft), with about 3,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sourdough Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Aurora Creek Trailhead, an 11.3-mile round trip to the top of Sourdough Mountain (4,602 ft), with about 5,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Gibson Peak
hikes.blurb: From Petes Creek Trailhead, a 5.2-mile round trip to the top of Gibson Peak (3,456 ft), with about 2,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Peak 4400
hikes.blurb: From Aurora Creek Trailhead, a 7.3-mile round trip to the top of Peak 4400 (4,307 ft), with about 4,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Muller
hikes.blurb: From Fairholme Olympic Discovery Trailhead, a 10.0-mile round trip to the top of Mount Muller (3,720 ft), with about 3,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cascade Falls
hikes.blurb: From Quinault Rain Forest Trailhead, a 3.9-mile round trip to Cascade Falls, with about 450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sol Duc Hot Springs
hikes.blurb: From Sol Duc Trailhead, a 5.1-mile round trip to Sol Duc Hot Springs, with about 400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Kloshe Nanitch
hikes.blurb: From Kloshe Nanitch Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to the Kloshe Nanitch viewpoint, with about 2,450 feet of climbing.
